headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a blowout loss to the Cleveland Guardians, while the New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays 7-1, and the Boston Red Sox edged the Baltimore Orioles 6-5 in a thrilling finish.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with Will Smith being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to neck inflammation. The Athletics placed Joshua Kuroda-Grauer on the 10-day injured list after ruptured testicle surgery and Mark Leiter Jr. on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 19 with a right hip impingement. Other teams have also reported injuries, including the San Francisco Giants, Philadelphia Phillies, Chicago White Sox, Boston Red Sox, and Miami Marlins.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Los Angeles Dodgers acquiring Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies for Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for Aiden Moffett, and the Baltimore Orioles acquired Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to Guardians in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 13-4 loss to the Cleveland Guardians, with the Guardians' offense dominating the game. Petey Halpin led the Guardians' charge with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Yankees in 5-8 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs. Wilber Dotel impressed on the mound for the Pirates with 3.0 scoreless innings, striking out 5 batters.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Blue Jays 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Nick Fortes leading the offense. Fortes hit a home run on a fly ball to left center field, contributing to his 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Rally Past Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox edged the Baltimore Orioles 6-5 in a closely contested matchup, securing their win in the final innings. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Shut Out by Yankees in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 0-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, marking a hard-fought win for the Yankees.

top_news.title: **Orioles' Shutout Bid Falls Short in Boston**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 0-0 win over the Baltimore Orioles, handing the visitors their loss.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Will Smith Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers catcher Will Smith has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to neck inflammation. The move comes after Smith was initially placed on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire Seth Halvorsen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired RHP Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies. In exchange, the Rockies received RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek.
